sfp.role: SFP port-face detector (both port faces of the NIC card)
sfp.training_run: aic_model/tools/train_sc_port_detector.py --landmarks sfp_faces --preprocessing rail_conditioned_v1 --epochs 40 --batch-size 16 --lr 3e-4 --negative-heatmap-weight 0.25 --seed 7, backbone initialized from an earlier SC detector
sfp.training_provenance: Retrained on the wide board-pose and rail-travel captures (validation split fixed before training); evaluated on the official qualification scenes, the sample config and wide-board generalization scenes.

sc.training_run: aic_model/tools/train_sc_port_detector.py --landmarks sc --preprocessing rail_conditioned_v1 --epochs 30 --batch-size 16 --lr 1e-4 --negative-heatmap-weight 0.25 --seed 7, initialized from an earlier SC detector
sc.training_provenance: Retrained on the wide board-pose and rail-travel captures (validation split fixed before training); evaluated on the official qualification scenes, the sample config and wide-board generalization scenes.

plug_sfp.role: SFP plug keypoints in the gripper
plug_sfp.training_provenance: Grasp measurement: 384 px crops, trained on 632 privileged collection trials covering normal and shifted grasps (plug up to 18 mm deeper along TCP z), 6 captures per trial; ground-truth labels from privileged collection only; validated per trial offline and on shifted-grasp scenes.

plug_sc.role: SC plug keypoints in the gripper
plug_sc.training_provenance: Grasp measurement: 384 px crops, trained on 632 privileged collection trials covering normal and shifted grasps (plug up to 18 mm deeper along TCP z), 6 captures per trial; ground-truth labels from privileged collection only; validated per trial offline and on shifted-grasp scenes.
